reason: ₹1,999 every month is about a sixth of what I earn in a month, and right now my wife washes clothes by hand for nothing. If I take on an EMI this year it will be for a bike or something for the farm, not a washing machine.
objection: For ₹22,000 I could get a normal machine for much less and run it on the inverter, or put the money toward a bigger inverter that runs the fan and lights too. A battery only for the washer feels like paying extra for one small problem.
would_change_my_mind: An EMI under ₹800 a month with no down payment, so it fits next to my other instalments.
